# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Top pick: Soundcore Space One (about $100, or $80 with a code)**
- BestProducts picked it as best overall under $100. It has adaptive ANC, rotating ear cups, a good companion app with EQ, and 55 hours of battery (ANC off). [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- Dealectric lists it at $99.99 at Soundcore's US store. It says the code AFSC20 brings it to $80, tested Oct 22 and expiring Dec 31, 2026. Battery with ANC on is 40 hours. [Buy link (affiliate)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one) · [Details](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100-2026-reviews-prices)
- Downsides: it's heavier than some rivals and has no sweat resistance.

**Best noise cancelling for the money: Anker Soundcore Space Q45 (about $100)**
- RTINGS found it the best budget ANC headphones it has tested. It quiets engine rumble and office chatter well, but its price hovers right around $100. Owners report the headband can crack, so handle it gently. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- The sources disagree on battery life: RTINGS says 28 hours, while CartIQ says 38 hours with ANC on. I'd trust the lab-tested figure.

**Cheaper options**
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q30 (under $100):** RTINGS's best over-ear under $100, with good ANC, a comfortable fit, and about 44 hours of battery. It leaks sound, which matters in a quiet office. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024):** RTINGS's best cheap pick. Its ANC is nearly as good as the Q45's, with 49 hours of battery, but it's weaker on bass rumble and the build feels plasticky. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Edifier Atom Max (about $45):** BestProducts' best budget pick, with ANC up to 44 dB and 45 hours of battery. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1More SonoFlow (Pro HQ51):** TechRadar's pick under $100, with satisfying, customizable sound. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Other picks**
- **Sony WH-CH720N (about $99):** very light at 192 g, with no LDAC. This is from CartIQ, which had some inconsistencies, so check the current price. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **CMF Headphone Pro:** the sturdiest budget build, with stainless steel hinges. RTINGS notes its noise isolation is weaker, and I didn't see a price for it. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **JBL Tune 760NC:** a good call mic and 40+ hours of battery, but only average ANC, and its price fluctuates. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)

**My recommendation:** if the $80 code works at checkout, get the Space One. If you want the strongest noise blocking and can accept a more fragile headband, get the Space Q45. If you're on a tight budget, the Life Q20 or Edifier Atom Max are good values. Prices change often, so confirm the current price before you buy.
